preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 40.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**4 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of ingredients N is between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K <= 10**9 for K in Ks)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the maximum amount of each ingredient K is between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == N for output_line, N in zip(output_lines, Ns))
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(amount) <= K for output_line, K in zip(output_lines, Ks) for amount in output_line.split())
postconditions.description: Each amount in the output is between 1 and K.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_line.split()[0]) ^ int(output_line.split()[1]) ^ ... ^ int(output_line.split()[-1]) == max_taste for output_line, max_taste in zip(output_lines, max_tastes))
postconditions.description: The taste of the cake, which is the bitwise XOR of all ingredient amounts, is maximized for each test case.
